transcript: Let me tell you something that takes people years to realize. Stress is not always caused by life. Most of the time, it is created by the way we resist life. My friend, anxiety is not a weakness in you. It is a signal, a message asking you to slow down, not to push harder. When the mind races, the breath becomes shallow. When the breath is shallow, the body believes it is in danger. And when the body feels unsafe, peace cannot enter. So we begin with simple medicine. One, return to the breath. Not forcefully, not dramatically. Just breathe a little slower than your thoughts. Long exhale. The body listens immediately. Two, warm the body. Cold creates tension. Warmth creates trust. Warm water in the morning. Warm foods. Protect your lower back and your feet. Calm begins with warmth. Three, reduce the noise. Endless scrolling. Endless urgency. Endless opinions. The nervous system was never designed for this speed. Even five minutes of silence each day can change everything. Silence is not emptiness. Silence is medicine. Four, release the need to control everything. Anxiety grows when we try to hold what cannot be held. Life softens when we soften first. Remember this, peace does not come from fixing everything. It comes from allowing yourself to feel safe where you are. If your heart feels tired, you are not broken. You are being called back to yourself. If you are ready for gentle guidance, the 30-day healing journey was created for moments like this. Only 10 quiet minutes a day. No pressure. No rush. You can begin when it feels right. You'll find the 30-day healing journey in the link on my profile. Move slowly. Breathe deeply. You are closer to peace than you think.
